name: Suburban Rail Loop East
notes: Twenty-six kilometres of twin tunnel and six new underground stations between Cheltenham and Box Hill, connecting to the Frankston, Cranbourne, Pakenham, Glen Waverley and Belgrave/Lilydale lines. Early works and tunnelling underway at multiple sites.

name: North East Link
notes: Twin three-lane tunnels connecting the M80 Ring Road at Greensborough to the Eastern Freeway at Bulleen, plus upgrades to the Eastern Freeway and a dedicated busway. Jointly funded by the Australian ($5B) and Victorian ($21.21B) governments. Tunnel boring on the northbound tunnel substantially complete as of mid-2026. Head contractor: Spark North East Link (John Holland, Gamuda, CPB Contractions, WSP).

name: Arden Urban Renewal Precinct
planned_completion: Ongoing — construction of Arden Central expected to commence 2026
notes: Employment and transport precinct around the Metro Tunnel's new Arden Station, targeting approximately 34,000 jobs and 20,000 residents. Planning amendment C489melb gazetted May 2026. A Master Developer for Arden Central is being selected from a shortlist, with a decision expected in 2026.

name: Fishermans Bend
notes: 480-hectare urban renewal precinct across Port Melbourne, South Melbourne and Montague, including planned tram extension and levee/drainage infrastructure. Led by Development Victoria.

name: Queen Victoria Market Renewal
value: $268 million (market renewal) — Gurrowa Place precinct development $1.7 billion
planned_completion: Market renewal substantially complete; Gurrowa Place construction to commence April 2026
notes: City of Melbourne's renewal of the Queen Victoria Market precinct. The Gurrowa Place southern precinct, developed with Lendlease, includes Market Square — the first new CBD park since 1980 — with construction expected to start April 2026.

name: West Gate Tunnel
notes: Twin road tunnels under Yarraville linking the West Gate Freeway to CityLink and the Port of Melbourne, with a widened West Gate Freeway and a new bridge over the Maribyrnong River. Head contractor: CPB Contractors / John Holland joint venture (Wurundjeri Way / Westgate Tunnel JV).

name: Melbourne Metro Tunnel
notes: Twin nine-kilometre rail tunnels and five new underground stations (Arden, Parkville, State Library, Town Hall, Anzac) linking the Sunbury and Cranbourne-Pakenham lines. Head contractor: Cross Yarra Partnership (CYP).
